# Poly Haven CC0 environment props

Acquired 2026-10-29 from Poly Haven, a source recommended in `Docs/RTS_ASSET_RESOURCE_RESEARCH.md`.
These are staging/source assets only: no Unreal import, package cook, or gameplay/content-definition changes were made.

## Included

| Asset | Creator | Potential POLITIKA use | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Concrete Road Barrier | Amal Kumar | Roadside/industrial-yard obstacle and environmental prop | https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_road_barrier |
| Barrel 03 | Serhii Khromov | Industrial-yard, depot, workshop, or warehouse prop | https://polyhaven.com/a/barrel_03 |

Each folder contains the original 2K Blender source and the corresponding 2K material maps referenced by it. The exact source API metadata and publisher MD5s are preserved in `source-info.json` and `source-files.json` per asset; SHA-256 checksums for the downloaded files are in `SHA256SUMS`.

Review their silhouette, scale, collisions, texture import settings, and RTS-camera readability before Unreal integration. Keep meshes/materials presentation-only; do not let decorative geometry silently change map traversal or gameplay acceptance.
